notes.title: The Bridge is a part of Indie Piñata - use received discounts to get similar games!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/XKh6EQD.png[/img]

The Bridge is a part of [b][url=http://indiepinata.com]Indie Piñata[/url][/b], an event organized by indie developers to promote similar titles, available on Steam, among enthusiasts of specific game genres.

http://youtu.be/41rlaIwZwBQ 

[h1]How does it work?[/h1]

It’s very simple – the event lasts for 10 days and during that time everybody who owns at least one title from our collection can get similar games, listed below, for a discounted price:

[list]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/113020/][b]Monaco: What’s yours is mine[/b] (-60%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/204240/][b]The Bridge[/b] (-60%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/229520/][b]Dungeon Hearts[/b] (-50%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/220900/][b]Jack Lumber[/b] (-50%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/95000/][b]Super Splatters[/b] (-50%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/260330/][b]Flockers[/b] (- 33%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/252750/][b]MouseCraft[/b] (-33%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/241240/][b]Contraption Maker[/b] (-50%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/209950/][b]Triple Town[/b] (-66%)[/url]

[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/227580/][b]10,000,000[/b] (-75%)[/url]

[/list] 

Visit [b][url=http://indiepinata.com]Indie Piñata website[/url][/b] for more details.

Thanks!
